title: driftline Source Manifest
description: Schema for .driftline-source.yaml in a Source Repository. Target paths are configured by Target Repositories, not in this manifest.

gitignore.description: Entries driftline appends to the Target Repository .gitignore.

files.description: Files made available by the Source Repository.

id.description: Stable file identifier used by Target Config entries.

source_path.description: Relative path to the file in the Source Repository.

if_not_exists.description: When true, driftline does not overwrite an existing target file.
